title: Slight Cooling Effect
text: Slight Cooling Effect. Just purchased these pillow cases to see if they help me with hot flashes in the night. They are cool to the touch at first, but then I find I still have to flip the pillow to get another cool side. I guess it's not the end of the world to do that. I was hoping for something a bit more long lasting, but I will still keep these cases.
